proposals.title: OpenVLA & LeRobot: Open-Source Vision-Language-Action Models
proposals.source: Kim et al. (2024), 'OpenVLA: An Open-Source Vision-Language-Action Model', arXiv:2406.09246; Cadene et al., Hugging Face LeRobot
proposals.summary: Open-source 7B parameter VLA model outperforming closed-source models in robotic manipulation; LeRobot provides PyTorch democratized robotic learning.
proposals.recommendation: Expand Unit 10 Module 04 to highlight OpenVLA and HuggingFace LeRobot as open-weight alternatives to proprietary Google RT-2 models.

proposals.title: ROS 2 Jazzy Jalisco (Ubuntu 24.04 LTS Release)
proposals.source: Open Robotics / ROS 2 Project (May 2024), 'ROS 2 Jazzy Jalisco Release Notes'
proposals.summary: ROS 2 Jazzy is the new Long Term Support (LTS) release supported through 2029 on Ubuntu 24.04 noble.
proposals.recommendation: Annotate Unit 8 Module 01 with a forward-compatibility callout for ROS 2 Jazzy Jalisco (LTS through 2029) alongside ROS 2 Humble (LTS through 2027).

proposals.title: Raspberry Pi RP2350 Dual Arm Cortex-M33 / RISC-V Microcontroller
proposals.source: Raspberry Pi Foundation (August 2024), 'Raspberry Pi Pico 2 and RP2350 Microcontroller Datasheet'
proposals.summary: Introduces selectable dual ARM Cortex-M33 and dual Hazard3 RISC-V cores with higher clock (150MHz) and hardware security at $5 retail.
proposals.recommendation: Update Unit 2 Module 03 hardware comparison table to reference RP2350 (Pico 2) alongside RP2040 (Pico 1).

proposals.title: Field-Oriented Control (SimpleFOC) for Hobby BLDC Actuators
proposals.source: Skuric et al. (2022-2024), 'SimpleFOC: Open-Source Field Oriented Control for Robotics Motors'
proposals.summary: Allows smooth, silent, high-torque robotic joint control using cheap brushless gimbal motors and magnetic angle encoders.
proposals.recommendation: Include an advanced spotlight in Unit 4 Module 01 showing how Field-Oriented Control (FOC) bridges the gap between steppers and industrial servos.

proposals.title: Webots ros2_control Hardware Interface Integration
proposals.summary: Deepened ros2_control simulation plugins allowing exact identical controller code to run in Webots and on physical hardware without changes.
proposals.recommendation: Reinforce the Sim2Real bridge in Unit 6 Module 04 by highlighting webots_ros2 interface nodes.
